contexts.text: When he begins to know that it is false that he lives from himself... he awakes as from sleep, and becomes awake.
I awoke from sleep in the night...
Noah awoke from his wine = when he was better instructed. AC 1090.
Some Spirits are kept in a middle state between wakefulness and sleep, and think very little; they only as it were awake by turns and remember what they had done in the bodily life...
Jacob awoke from his sleep = enlightenment... To awake from sleep = to be enlightened.
His Intellectual is illuminated, and his case is like that of a person awaking from sleep in the early morning...
Pharaoh awoke = a state of enlightenment in the Natural... To awake = to be enlightened. AC 5218.
All who in the world have lived in good... appear to themselves, when let into the state of their interiors, like those who having been awaked from sleep come into wakefulness...
To sleep and to awake = the life of man in the world which is natural, and his life after death which is spiritual. TCR 199:2.
He is like one who rouses from sleep... (Under Awake, see this reference.)
On awaking from sleep one morning I saw two Angels descending from Heaven... TCR 386.
[155a]. One morning very sweet singing... roused me...
